speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: The Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth’s (MCCY) mission is to build a caring, cohesive and confident nation, where everyone feels they belong and is inspired to work towards a common future.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: Through the Forward Singapore exercise, Singaporeans came up with ideas to strengthen our solidarity and mutual responsibility as one united people.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: MCCY will partner Singaporeans to act on these ideas to build a better and stronger Singapore for all and generations to come.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: MCCY will continue to develop our arts, heritage, and sports facilities and programmes as common spaces for people to come together to build shared memories.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: The Peranakan Museum and Children’s Museum recently opened with refreshed and interactive exhibits that tell the Singapore story.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: Our festivals, such as the Singapore International Festival of Arts, Singapore Art Week, and Singapore Heritage Festival, bring Singaporeans together to celebrate our arts achievements and heritage.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: MCCY is committed to growing a vibrant arts, heritage, and sports sector, that reinforces our shared identity as Singaporeans, instils national pride and confidence in our achievements and people, and fosters an inclusive society where individuals’ skills and talent, especially in the arts and sports domains, are valued.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: We are unlocking new opportunities with the next iteration of Our SG Arts Plan and Our SG Heritage Plan.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: We are also updating the Disability Sports Master Plan to set out pathways for aspiring para-athletes, and to enable persons of different abilities to participate in sport.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: MCCY will continue to support artists and athletes, including through new and enhanced facilities, greater support for self-employed practitioners to grow and innovate, and uplifting sector capabilities.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: We must continue to build a deep reserve of social capital and trust and nurture the “gotong royong” spirit.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: MCCY will continue to facilitate opportunities for Singaporeans to donate or volunteer for causes they are passionate about, through platforms such as Youth Corps Singapore, Team Nila, and our network of SG Cares Volunteer Centres across 24 towns.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: Through partners like the National Volunteer and Philanthropy Centre (NVPC), Community Foundation of Singapore, and Singapore Kindness Movement, we will promote care for each other as an integral part of Singapore culture and everyday life.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: The People’s Association will increase opportunities for citizens to be involved in community service and improvement projects in their local neighbourhoods.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: Schools remain an important common space to develop cross-cultural understanding and friendships from an early age.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: Across ages, our arts and sports programmes, such as the Children’s Season, Children’s Biennale, and Active Parents, encourage family bonding, while our Active Silver Hubs promote intergenerational bonding and help seniors stay active.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: Demographic and societal shifts require us to continually reforge the bonds of trust among our diverse communities.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: Together with community partners, such as our Self-Help Groups, MCCY will facilitate mutual support across ethnic communities to ensure that the fruits of growth and progress are shared by all.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: We have refreshed existing platforms such as our Racial and Religious Harmony Circles so that they remain relevant in fostering social harmony and enhanced the Community Dispute Management Framework to promote pro-social behaviour and good neighbourliness.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: MCCY will continue to build a resilient society where the Government and other stakeholders, including businesses, communities and individual Singaporeans, tackle challenges together.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: Businesses have a role to play in strengthening our social fabric.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: MCCY is supporting the NVPC and the Singapore Business Federation to grow the number of businesses that generate value for society at large.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: Corporate bodies can step up to provide volunteer mentors or opportunities for their employees to be mentored.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: Every individual contributes to society in their roles as family member, citizen and worker.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: We encourage all Singaporeans to partner the Government in refreshing our social compact through the Forward Singapore exercise.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: In our engagements, many Singaporeans were enthusiastic about playing a bigger role in shaping our future, including by contributing ideas, shaping policy and participating in new forms of engagement and partnership.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: They also agreed that closer collaboration and partnership between the Government and other stakeholders in society was essential in the next phase of nation-building.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: We see healthy, sustained youth interest in policy making.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: Somerset Belt will be a refreshed and vibrant precinct for youths, with youths, and by youths.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: Young people can lend their voices to shape Somerset Belt into a space to experiment in and call their own.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: We will continue to create new platforms to give our youth opportunities to shape Singapore.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: MCCY will rally and support Singaporeans in achieving these ideals and aspirations, to build a stronger and better society.
